title: Injective middle term: the Cech local-lift cocycle is the connecting class
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let 0 \to A \to I \to Q \to 0 be a short exact sequence of sheaves of O_X-modules with I injective in Mod(O_X) [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] [def-sp-injective-resolutions], and let U = {U_i} be an open covering of X. For q in H^0(X,Q), choose lifts x_i in I(U_i) of q|_{U_i}. Then (x_{i_0}|_{U_{i_0} cap U_{i_1}} - x_{i_1}|_{U_{i_0} cap U_{i_1}}) is an A-valued Cech 1-cocycle, and the canonical map c_A from Cech H^1(U,A) to H^1(X,A) sends its class to the connecting class partial(q) for this short exact sequence.
